proposal.summary: Installer for AMD Ryzen Master fails to validate privileges during installation, allowing a low-privileged user to modify files which may lead to privilege escalation and code execution.
proposal.cwe_quote:
Failure to validate privileges during installation of AMD Ryzen™ Master may allow an attacker with low
privileges to modify files potentially leading to privilege escalation and code execution by the lower
privileged user.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request from the reporter or vendor: exact affected versions, detailed installation steps demonstrating the privilege validation failure, and a proof-of-concept showing file modifications and whether code execution occurs; obtain installer behavior and required privileges.
